title: LayerNorm, GELU and the feed-forward block
hints: LayerNorm normalizes each token's vector over the last axis: mean(-1, keepdims=True) and var(-1, keepdims=True) (population variance), then (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * g + b.
GELU, tanh form: 0.5 * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(2 / pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x ** 3))).
The feed-forward block is two matmuls with the nonlinearity in between, gelu(x @ W1 + b1) @ W2 + b2, with a hidden width of 4 * d_model.
